hard_stops.hard_stop: Any credential value would need to be chosen, generated, or written.
A done-criterion turns out to be impossible, or already true for a reason the packet did not anticipate.
The change would break something outside allowed_paths.
Two reasonable implementations exist and the packet does not say which.
Satisfying one instruction in this packet would require violating another.

Resolving one of proposal.md's three Open Questions turns out to require a genuine product decision beyond engineering judgment (e.g. it materially changes user-facing behavior already confirmed with the human). Name the exact tension; do not decide it unilaterally.
